title: October 11, 2018 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 11, 2018 
9:00 AM 
BARTON SPRINGS MUNICIPAL POOL,  
2131 WILLIAM BARTON DR. 
AUSTIN, TX 78746 
 
Council Cleans Barton Springs Pool Day 
 
9:00 AM 
Attend an event hosted by Friends of Barton Springs Pool, including a presentation 
on recent Barton Springs Pool Projects and a tour and cleaning of the pool.  
 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
